title: Rb-driven transcription limits its tumour-suppressive effects in breast cancer.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: GEO (Gene Expression Omnibus) SuperSeries GSE303576 metadata: 23 SubSeries, 279 samples, combined RAW.tar is 10.46 GB (HEAD only). Listed every SubSeries: 14 bulk RNA-seq raw-count CSVs (6-36 samples each) and 9 CUT&RUN/DynaTag chromatin-binding series (4-12 samples each, bigwig + narrowPeak files; GSE303330 RAW.tar alone is 2.0 GB, bigwigs ~110-260 MB each). Downloaded and parsed GSE307843 raw counts: 60,656 Ensembl gene rows x 12 samples (MCF7 parent vs RB1-knockout, abemaciclib vs DMSO, 3 replicates each), integer counts only, no fold-change or label column.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: PRIDE PXD066496 proteomics, POP clinical-trial microarray data at Institut Curie, patient-derived xenograft details, and Supplementary Tables 1-6 contents (Europe PMC supplementary endpoint timed out, so these tables were not retrievable). C2 literature search was not run because Part A failed.

a1_downloadable.note: Open GEO downloads; count CSV fetched and parsed. Checked in files.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No label column exists. The only plausible target (Rb-dependent change in gene expression under CDK4/6 inhibition) must be constructed by differential-expression analysis of raw counts, with an interaction contrast across knockout and drug arms; chromatin features must also be built from bigwig/peak files. Checked in files.

a3_inputs_present.note: Bigwig and narrowPeak (called binding peak) files are present per sample, but require genome-coordinate processing to become per-gene features. Seen in GEO file listing.

a4_units_stated.note: Raw integer read counts per Ensembl gene; units are unambiguous. Checked in files.

a5_enough_rows.note: Each experiment has 6-36 samples (12 in the file opened); the biological unit is a handful of cell lines under a few conditions. Treating ~20,000 genes as rows gives one contrast from one cell line, not independent examples.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: Count CSVs <1 MB each; chromatin bigwigs 2-10 GB total
a6_fits_laptop.note: Counts fit trivially; chromatin features would need streaming of large bigwigs. Sizes seen via HEAD and file list.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: 12-sample MCF7 RB1-knockout design matches the paper's described triplicate design; not cross-checked against every figure.

a8_label_provenance.note: Expression changes come from measured RNA-seq, not a model's prediction.

backbone.name: None evaluated; AlphaGenome or Enformer-style DNA models would be the natural fit for promoter/enhancer sequence features

integration.join_key: Ensembl gene ID (present in count files)

controls.positive_control: Classic E2F cell-cycle genes (e.g. E2F1, CCNE2) should be repressed by CDK4/6 inhibition in an Rb-dependent way.
controls.external_validation: POP clinical trial microarrays (per paper; not opened).

honest_claim_h3: At best: predicts which genes MCF7/ZR-75-1 breast cancer cell lines up- or down-regulate in an Rb-dependent way after CDK4/6 inhibition, from Rb/ER binding in those same cells.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use where the Rb protein and oestrogen receptor bind DNA to predict which genes switch on when breast cancer cells get CDK4/6 blockers.
plain_idea.train_on: Per gene: chromatin-binding signals (Rb, ER, KDM5A, histone marks) near its promoter and enhancers, built from bigwig files; roughly 20,000 genes but from 2-3 cell lines.
plain_idea.predict: The change in that gene's expression after abemaciclib, minus the change in RB1-knockout cells, computed by differential-expression analysis from raw RNA-seq counts (12 samples in the file checked).
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would flag Rb-activated pro-growth genes as combination-therapy targets, but the paper's own peak-overlap analysis already answers this for these cell lines.

label_elsewhere.sources: Known resources: LINCS L1000 includes CDK4/6 inhibitor (palbociclib) expression signatures in some cell lines; not searched here.
label_elsewhere.join_key: Gene symbol / Ensembl gene + cell line
label_elsewhere.why: Other drug-response expression sets could add contrasts, but not Rb-knockout-paired ones.

ml_idea: Gene-level regression of Rb-dependent expression change under CDK4/6 inhibition from Rb/ER/KDM5A CUT&RUN signal; rejected because the label must be built by differential expression from 6-36-sample experiments and the features from multi-GB bigwigs.

effort.compute_note: Estimated from file sizes seen in GEO listings; nothing timed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count independent conditions with paired parent/RB1-knockout x drug/DMSO RNA-seq: about 5 cell-line contexts, which already kills it.

verdict_reason: Mechanistic cell-line study: GEO holds raw counts (e.g. 60,656 genes x 12 samples) and CUT&RUN bigwigs with no label column. Any target has to be built by differential expression across a few cell lines (A2), and the independent sample count is tiny (A5).
